reason: The inspected encoded frames and delivery records support a coherent product demonstration, explicit owner-supplied price, stable CTA and technically complete downloadable deliverable. I cannot certify the required natural narration and absence of residual music: the evidence explicitly lacks human listening after learned vocal separation. This is a production-evidence gap, not a claim that the audio is defective. Audience conversion data is not required for this production task and its absence is not a rejection reason.

evidence.inspection: Personally inspected through view_image. Faceless opening at 0/1.04s; product visible at 8.65s; product contents at 12.575s; training choices at 15.70s; actual-app calculator and recipe presentations at 18.55/22.775s; readable 15.99 SAR, store address and purchase invitation at 27.65/29.70s. These are still samples, not continuous viewing.

Personally inspected through view_image. Sampled scene changes retain a separate caption band and use the book, menu, app and closing product as visual anchors. Closing scene appears by 26.08s; source-browser.json records full settling at 26.35s and a 3.45s hold.

Baseline is 510x1108, approximately 30fps and 42.836667s despite its smooth_60fps.mp4 name. Its source file SHA-256 was independently recomputed as b9cd6deaafe9d94695c36554cc73b73eb86e2789febe1f9685683c8e5054a0c2 and matches baseline-source.json. This supports technical comparison only.

Reports 1080x1920, 60/1fps, 1788 frames, 29.8s, no decode warnings and distinct frames in the sampled moving window. Independently recomputed delivered MP4 hash 0d741b5bef0424be521ba9938e891d8a4f6163b7e075e4cab592f3f8f8ff3940 matches the frozen manifest.

Recorded live page/video hashes match local files; HTTP 200 and video range 206 are recorded. Player tests record decoding, seeking, download links and no horizontal overflow at 320/390/1440 widths. I read the delivered HTML and verified its hash against the manifest; it contains MP4/audio/SRT downloads and an explicit product-page link. I did not independently make a purchase or repeat live browser testing.

Source excerpts, mild EQ, no pitch/time change and no music track added are documented. Learned vocal separation explicitly does not establish perfect removal or naturalness. The ASR opening has transcription errors; those errors cannot distinguish dialect/model limitations from perceptual audio defects.

strengths: The intended viewer action is concrete: obtain بروتوكول التحول, with product, owner-authorized 15.99 SAR price and store destination held together at the end.
The sequence connects the beginner's uncertainty to contents and actual app examples rather than unsupported testimonials or outcome promises.
Claims are scoped: 500 recipes are identified as in the application; calculator and recipe demonstrations are labeled as examples/estimates.

issues.requirement: Smooth natural source narration; no music
issues.detail: Human or otherwise valid perceptual listening evidence is absent after vocal separation and phrase editing. Technical loudness, source preservation, ASR and software playback do not close that gap.
issues.needed: An honest listening review of the final encoded audio confirming natural phrase joins, intelligibility and no audible residual music.

objections: Do not translate improved resolution/frame cadence, earlier reveal or this editorial review into a conversion-lift claim.
limitations: No audience, click, purchase, exposure, spend, attribution or randomized comparison dataset was supplied. There is no measured conversion rate, lift or benchmark in this verdict.
Several variables change together, including duration, resolution, motion, reveal timing, demonstrations and CTA. Even future unadjusted before/after sales differences would be confounded.

Baseline inspection covered actual source identity and probe records, not visual playback; relative visual-polish and exact character resemblance are not independently established by my baseline review.
I inspected encoded still sheets and exact files/reports, and did not watch continuous video or hear audio.
No checkout, fulfillment, store price reconciliation, clinical validation or count of all other expert agents was independently verified.
non_applicable_criteria: Campaign conversion definition and attribution validation are outside this production acceptance task. The creative's purchase invitation is identifiable; campaign success is unmeasured.
Audience-data quality, statistical significance and causal performance comparison are not assessable without campaign data and are not prerequisites for delivering the requested ad.
